title: feat: implement L2 roadmap features for console (Phases 6, 13–17)
body:
Advances the console roadmap from L1-complete to L2-partial across six phases, adding production-level features to collaboration, kanban, forms, sharing, undo, and comments.

### Presence Avatars (Phase 6 L2)
- Integrated `PresenceAvatars` from `@object-ui/collaboration` into `AppHeader` (global online users) and `RecordDetailView` (per-record viewers)
- Uses mock presence data in dev mode; wired for real WebSocket presence when server is available

### Kanban Swimlanes (Phase 13 L2)
- Added `swimlaneField` to `KanbanSchema` and plumbed through `KanbanRenderer` → `KanbanBoardInner`
- When set, renders a 2D grid: columns × swimlane rows with collapsible lane headers and per-lane card counts

```tsx
<KanbanBoard columns={columns} swimlaneField="priority" />
```

### Form URL Prefill (Phase 14 L2)
- `EmbeddableForm` now auto-reads `window.location.search` params as initial field data
- Explicit `prefillParams` prop takes priority over URL params for the same key

### Shared View Link Protection (Phase 15 L2)
- Added password input and expiration dropdown (1/7/30/90 days) to `SharedViewLink` popover
- `onShare` callback signature extended: `(url, { password?, expiresAt? }) => void`
- Badges indicate protection status after link generation

### Undo/Redo Toast (Phase 16 L2)
- Wired `useGlobalUndo` into `AppContent` with Sonner toast notifications showing operation descriptions on Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z

### Comment Sorting & Reactions (Phase 17 L2)
- Added sort dropdown (oldest/newest) to `CommentThread` header
- Added emoji reaction buttons (👍 ❤️) with toggle semantics and count display
- New `onReaction?: (commentId, emoji) => void` callback prop
- `RecordDetailView` wires reaction state management

### Tests
30 new tests across 4 files: `KanbanSwimlanes`, `SharedViewLinkPassword`, `CommentThreadSortReactions`, `EmbeddableFormPrefill`. All 544+ existing tests continue to pass.
